title: Rebuild replaces a checked column without losing its data
setup: CREATE TABLE bins (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, free INTEGER CHECK (free >= 0));
migration: CREATE TABLE next_bins (id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY, used INTEGER CHECK (used BETWEEN 0 AND 10));
INSERT INTO next_bins SELECT id, 10 - free FROM bins;
ALTER TABLE next_bins RENAME TO bins;
INSERT INTO probe SELECT count(*) FROM bins WHERE id = 1 AND used = 7;
